desc:
🏜️🚙 Empty Quarter Desert Trip

Your journey begins at a farm on the edge of the Empty Quarter, accompanied by a car that needs repairs. Prepare it and embark on an adventure across the desert!

🔧 Gather your car parts, install the engine and tires, and fill up with gas before the trip.
🛣️ Explore the dunes and prepare your vehicle for sand road challenges.
🗺️ Start in the Empty Quarter and unlock new worlds soon.
🎮 Discover the secrets of Story Mode, or try Endless Mode and see how far you can go.
🔎 Explore abandoned places and collect tools to help you continue your journey.
🚘 Meet travelers and participate in various challenges on the road.
🛻 Unlock off-road vehicles and customize your car to your taste.
👥 Enjoy the adventure alone or with your friends.

Every journey has a story... Where will your journey take you?

Press R to start the machine.
The game is in development and may encounter some bugs.
